- gRPC-Gateway REST/JSON — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:107` (`RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`, mounted at `v1.go:126-128`); generated glue `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`

**q20.** Server-Sent Events (SSE); hub `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:56` (`SSEHub`, `Broadcast` at :115; HTTP endpoint `sse_handler.go:25,34`). Broadcasting memo handlers: `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` (`memo_service.go:163`), `APIV1Service.DeleteMemo` (`memo_service.go:585`), `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (called from UpdateMemo, `memo_update_helpers.go:71`), `APIV1Service.CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:126`), plus reactions (`reaction_service.go:106,161`).

(plus tests: `server/router/api/v1/test/*`, `store/test/user_test.go`, `store/test/user_delete_test.go`, `store/demo_seed_test.go`)

**q22.** dispatcher — `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (called at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`), funneling into `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); delivery package — `internal/webhook` (`PostAsync` → `Post`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184,120`); signing — Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID.timestamp.body` with a `whsec_`-prefixed base64 secret, sent as `webhook-id` / `webhook-timestamp` / `webhook-signature: v1,<b64>` headers (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:131-150`, key resolution :97)

**q23.**
```
SQL schema: store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:33 (also postgres/LATEST.sql, mysql/LATEST.sql)
Go store model: store/memo.go:34
API proto message: proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:198
Generated frontend types: web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:79
```

**q24.**
```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178   (useCreateMemo → memoServiceClient.createMemo :183)
web/src/connect.ts:197                (memoServiceClient)
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21    (rpc CreateMemo)

store/memo.go:109                     (Store.CreateMemo → driver)
store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16            (DB.CreateMemo — SQL INSERT)
```

**q25.** CEL (google/cel-go) — engine in `internal/filter/` (`internal/filter/engine.go:24-33`, schema `schema.go`). The CEL AST is compiled to a dialect-agnostic condition tree, then rendered to a SQL fragment + args by `internal/filter/render.go` for the requested dialect; each driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.DialectSQLite|DialectPostgres|DialectMySQL, &where, &args)` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`; `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`).

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (`store/memo.go:140-158`); comment memos deleted first recursively hit the same three tables (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-577`). `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but not deleted.

**q27.** Go `embed` of the built `dist/` bundle served by Echo static middleware with SPA fallback — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21,41-59`; wired at `server/server.go:72` (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`)

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — RunOnce at startup, then time.Ticker every 12h (server/server.go:161-172; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
store cache cleanup goroutines (3, one per cache) — time.Ticker every 5m (store/cache/cache.go:83,201; store/store.go:42,51-53)
SSE heartbeat — per-connection ticker, not a server-wide runner (server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:64)
```
Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (full cron/job scheduler package) is referenced only by its own tests — no production code imports it. `memopayload.Runner`/`RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19,27`) is never instantiated by the server; only `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is called inline (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**q29.** interceptor — `web/src/connect.ts:156` (`authInterceptor`, installed on the transport at :188). Tokens: a short-lived access token held in memory/localStorage and sent as `Authorization: Bearer` (`web/src/auth-state.ts:1-19`), refreshed via an HTTP-only refresh-token cookie sent with `credentials: "include"` through `AuthService.RefreshToken` (`web/src/connect.ts:60-80`; cookie issued in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:27-47`); personal access tokens are also accepted server-side. Backend validation package — `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `token.go`), invoked via `NewAuthorizer`/`NewAuthInterceptor` (`server/router/api/v1/authz.go`, `v1.go:65,133`).

**q30.**
```
memo created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called at memo_service.go:157)
memo updated: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called at memo_update_helpers.go:67)
memo deleted: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called at memo_service.go:562)
comment created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called at memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four deliver via `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, `:120`).
